_comment: iOS-only strings with no counterpart in the web app's translation
dictionary - mostly VoiceOver labels and platform-specific wording
that has no web equivalent to borrow.
These are emitted into en.lproj ONLY, deliberately. iOS falls back to
the development language for any key missing from the active .lproj,
so a French user sees correct French for every shared key and English
for these few until they are translated in Phase 17. That is honest
fallback behaviour - it is NOT the same as shipping machine-invented
translations, which this project does not do.
